description: Outbound transport handoff manifest emitted by the himawari outbound_logistics cell (輸送 handoff → hikari install site). Composes kami-autodrive GNC (ADR-2606010600, LANDED) — himawari produces the goal + VehicleClass + encrypted route request; it never re-implements the perception→plan→control loop. Cross-border legs drive the EXISTING open-customs-clearance BPMN (com.etzhayyim.apps.customsClearance.*) rather than forking a parallel customs engine. G13 (transport bound by kami-autodrive gates — no weaponization · encrypted telemetry · own-module → hikari only, N10) + G12 (no external commercial PV carriage; SBT↔SBT internal carve-out, ADR-2605192115 §3) structural enforcement. Closes the 製造→積込→輸送→設置 chain (chains loadingRecord ← panel_loading; → hikari). Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID. Per ADR-2606021200.

manifestId.description: himawari-assigned outbound manifest identifier; root of the customs declaration + release-shipment + route-request handles for this leg

recordedAt.description: manifest emission timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this carriage

loadingId.description: loadingId of the upstream loadingRecord (積込) this manifest carries; binds carrier handoff to the F10 LoaderRobot cycle (G7 lineage)

loadingRecordCid.description: content-addressed CID of the upstream loadingRecord (panel_loading handoff); chains 積込 → 輸送 in the kotoba Datom log

moduleSerials.description: PV module serials on this carriage; each chains via moduleAttestation → cellBatch → waferBatch → feedstock lot (G11 serial↔lot traceability)

consigneeDid.description: G13/G12/N10: destination DID — MUST be a hikari install site (did:web:etzhayyim.com:hikari*). Non-hikari consignees are rejected before a manifest is ever emitted (no external commercial logistics carriage)

destinationKind.description: G12/N10 constant: own-module → internal hikari install only (SBT↔SBT carve-out, ADR-2605192115 §3); never an external market consignee

originSite.description: DID of the dispatching himawari fab site (default did:web:etzhayyim.com:himawari); route origin

carrierClass.description: kami-autodrive VehicleClass for this leg (ADR-2606010600 src/classes.rs::VehicleClass). himawari composes these; it does not define new vehicle classes. funadaiku/funamori marine carriage maps to `ship`

transportMode.description: physical transport mode; long marine legs default carrierClass to `ship`, otherwise the road default used by sarutahiko

routeRequest.description: the kami-autodrive route request this cell emits; the composition seam — GNC executes the drive, himawari never re-implements the loop

customs.description: customs decision for this leg — either a cross-border declaration bound to the open-customs-clearance BPMN, or an explicit domestic-skip record

telemetryEncrypted.description: G13 invariant surfaced for on-chain audit: carriage telemetry rides the encrypted envelope (com.etzhayyim.encrypted.telemetry). MUST be true for a valid handoff

weaponizationPayload.description: G13 invariant surfaced for on-chain audit: MUST be false — no weaponization payload is ever attached to the carriage (ADR-2605192100 §1.12 force-separation)

attestingRobots.description: Ed25519 robot witness attestation over the handoff bundle (loader / GNC dispatch). G7-coupled: automated-away human dispatch tasks remain accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000)

adr.description: provenance ADR tag for this record (ADR-2606021200)

routeRequest.description: kami-autodrive route request (ADR-2606010600, LANDED). The composition seam: himawari supplies origin/destination/class + waypoints; the GNC stack (perception→plan→control) executes the drive.

gnc.description: the GNC stack that executes this carriage (ADR-2606010600); himawari does not fork it

vehicleClass.description: kami-autodrive VehicleClass; mirrors the top-level carrierClass

origin.description: route origin DID (dispatching himawari fab site)

destination.description: route destination DID (hikari install site; G13-constrained)

waypoints.description: ordered intermediate waypoints for the GNC plan (may be empty)

telemetryChannel.description: G13 encrypted telemetry channel for in-transit reporting (com.etzhayyim.encrypted.telemetry)

customs.description: Customs decision for the leg. Cross-border legs carry a lodgeDeclaration input + the releaseShipment handle bound to the EXISTING open-customs-clearance BPMN (com.etzhayyim.apps.customsClearance.*); domestic legs record an explicit skip. himawari never invents a parallel customs engine.

required.description: whether a customs declaration is required (false for domestic legs)

reason.description: explanation when no declaration is required (e.g. domestic leg)

engine.description: the customs engine driven (com.etzhayyim.apps.customsClearance) — do NOT fork

bpmn.description: path to the open-customs-clearance BPMN definition driven for this leg

lodgeDeclaration.description: the com.etzhayyim.apps.customsClearance.lodgeDeclaration input for a cross-border leg

releaseShipmentRef.description: handle to the releaseShipment leg that must be satisfied before GNC carriage departs bond

lodgeDeclaration.description: Input contract for com.etzhayyim.apps.customsClearance.lodgeDeclaration on a cross-border leg. HS 8541.43 = photovoltaic cells assembled in modules.

manifestVid.description: the outbound manifest id this declaration covers

hsCode.description: HS tariff code (default 854143 — photovoltaic cells in modules)

declaredValueUsd.description: declared customs value (USD; integer). Note: G12 — no external commercial sale; value is for customs/transit accounting only, not a market price

importerLei.description: importer Legal Entity Identifier, if applicable

sanctionsScreeningVid.description: reference to the sanctions-screening attestation for this leg

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation over the handoff bundle. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human dispatch tasks remain accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested handoff bundle
